source:
I called in a civilian assistance request 12 hours after Everly Praetis was reported missing. Bill Steely’s bloodhound found her remains. Location of crime scene is Pine Hills Park, coordinates 36.6831° N, 83.8218° W. 

Head is dismembered… body is next to it. Appears victim was executed via beheading on a stump by an old grave and died immediately. Back of head has large welt from blunt force trauma.  

Standard 28-inch splitting axe, blood on the blade. Left it in the tree stump. Initial investigation reveals no sign of struggle from victim. No dirt, skin, or hair under fingernails… lipstick, earrings, and make-up is in-tact on the severed head, save for dirt and leaves. Clothing appears unmolested. Nothing missing from victim’s wallet. Phone and pendant necklace with victim’s face found in coat pocket. 

Two pairs of shoe tracks lead to execution site. Both approximately same size and tread…  identical to the victim’s shoes. Tracks disappear at location of homicide. Bloodhound did not pick up further scents to follow from there. (Assisting Officer Walrod vomited near the crime scene. Sent him off to get a grip and bring coffee for incoming investigators.)
target:
艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯通報失蹤十二小時後，我請求民間協助。比爾・史蒂利的尋血獵犬找到她的遺體。犯罪現場位於松丘公園，座標北緯 36.6831°、西經 83.8218°。

頭部遭斬斷……身體就在旁邊。看來死者在一座老墳旁的樹樁上被斬首處決，當場死亡。後腦有鈍器撞擊造成的大塊腫傷。

一般二十八吋劈木斧，斧刃帶血。留在樹樁上。初步調查未見死者掙扎跡象。指甲下沒有泥土、皮膚或毛髮……斷首上的口紅、耳環與妝容完整，只有些泥土和落葉。衣物似未遭拉扯。皮夾內無物品遺失。手機與刻有死者肖像的墜鍊，於外套口袋內尋獲。

兩組鞋印通往處決現場。尺寸與鞋底紋路大致相同……與死者的鞋完全一致。鞋印在命案發生處消失。尋血獵犬未能從該處嗅出其他可追蹤氣味。
（協助辦案的沃爾羅德警員在現場附近嘔吐。已叫他離開，冷靜一下，並為即將抵達的調查員帶咖啡。）

source:
Deputy Gilmartin cordoned the crime scene. Called investigation units from nearby Bronson and Riverneck counties. Notified Mayor Van Eisen of events and that crime report would come ASAP.   

Investigators arrive at 7:05 am and take photos. Blood, hair, fingerprint, and saliva samples gathered for DNA analysis. Body eventually removed for drug testing and autopsy by coroner. 

Drove to the Praetis house at 8:23 am and reported the incident to Everly’s husband, Danny. First time I saw a man wail like that. The two kids… 

Helped phone nearby family members to come over for support.
target:
吉爾馬丁副警長封鎖犯罪現場。召請鄰近布朗森郡與河頸郡的調查單位。已通知范艾森鎮長事件經過，並告知將儘快提交案情報告。

調查員於上午 7:05 抵達並拍照。採集血液、毛髮、指紋與唾液樣本，進行 DNA 分析。之後移走遺體，由法醫進行藥物檢驗與解剖。

上午 8:23 開車前往普雷蒂斯家，向艾芙莉的丈夫丹尼告知事件。第一次看見一個男人那樣嚎啕大哭。那兩個孩子……

協助致電附近親屬，請他們前來支持。

source: 2081. A period of endless of rain transforms the region into a shallow sea. Here, between endless horizons of fresh water, stilted on top of the concrete structures of the past, is the village of Aslandia. Like a society on lillypads, large huts and shanties are interconnected by makeshift bridges, docks, piers, and small boats built from the trees of the nearby pine forest shooting up through the water. When the men return from hunting seal and diving for oyster and the women have finished weaving rope and salting fish, the elders build a great fire to tell stories of the past. Stories about the strange things below the surface, buried in the mud. Like cars, computers, and silly green papers called "money."
target: 2081 年。無止盡的雨，將這片地區化為淺海。在一望無際的淡水地平線之間，阿斯蘭迪亞村架立於昔日的混凝土建築之上。彷彿睡蓮葉上的社會，大型棚屋與簡陋小屋，以臨時搭建的橋、碼頭、棧橋與小船互相連接，木材來自附近破水而出的松林。男人獵完海豹、潛水採完牡蠣歸來，女人也編完繩、醃好魚後，長老便燃起大火，講述過去的故事。那些故事談到水面下、埋在泥裡的奇怪東西。像汽車、電腦，還有叫作「錢」的可笑綠紙。

source: May 5, 2034. Everly Praetis ceases to be. But she is never forgotten. In her place, through centuries of trouble and turmoil in Asbury Pines, the Praetis family perseveres. Her memory holds the truth they carry. The truth that shapes the world. The truth that is carved into her bronze statue at the gates of Quent: “In the past we are found.”
target: 2034 年 5 月 5 日。 艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯不復存在。但她永遠不會被遺忘。 她離去後，歷經阿斯伯里松林鎮數百年的艱難與動盪，普雷蒂斯家族仍然堅持下去。對她的記憶，承載著他們傳下的真理。塑造世界的真理。銘刻在昆特城門旁，她那尊銅像上的真理：「在過去中，找到我們。」

source: Based on examinations of recurring features in neolithic artifacts, such as sloth-diefication, most researchers believe that at least some neolithic persons revered Megatherium, commonly known as the Giant Sloth.
target: 根據新石器時代文物中反覆出現的特徵，例如將樹懶神化的表現，多數研究者認為，至少有部分新石器時代居民崇拜Megatherium，也就是一般所稱的巨樹懶。
